book.name: Matthew
book.title: Rongmwehu ma ne insingdi jang ipen Matthew

content: Padahk in mihn Mehjjok
Pharisee pwi apel jounpadahk in Kojonnedpwi indoa jang Jerusalem indoa ipen Jesus, idoak oang Ih,
“Amwda nihmw sohnpadahkkok kin joah kapwaihahda asai siahk koadoaudoaudo jang jamasai mihn mehjjok? Irai joh kin amwunla poahrai mwohn arai mwinge!”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “A amwda kamwai ke japeik oang kojonned in Koahs nehn amwai kin pein daur amwai padahk kan?
Pwa Koahs pwa, ‘Woaunki joamoamw apel inoamw, a ma armaj men lahlahwe jamah ke inah, en kojkojdi.’
A kamwai kin padahki, ma armaj men ma anki mehkij ma ih kak jeuweje ki jamah ke inah, a ih pwa, ‘Me en Koahs,’
Irai johpwa anahne woaunki jamarai,
ioar doar amwai kin mwamwahlki Mahjan in Koahs, pwa kamwai en daur pein amwai padahk kan.
Mwalaunpwi kamwai! Mehlel oar pwa uhdahn pwung oang kamwai dahkij joukohp Isaiah ne kohpda oang kamwai nehn ah pwa,
‘Koahs pwa, armaj pwiai kin woaunki Ngoahi jang in arai lal
a mohngiongirai inenin dohjang Ngoahi.
Johpwa kaspoan ahr kin joarwihoang Ngoahi,
pwa irai kin padahkki kojonned in armaj, a irai karaunki pwa en Koahs Kojonned.’”

content: Da ma kin kajaminihla armaj
Doar Jesus ken pangindo pokonno Ipoa, pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai rong apel woahwoahki mwehu me:
Johpwa mehkij ma kin aluhwoang nehn oawoan armaj ma kin kajaminihla armaj, pwa me ma kin injang nehn oawoa.”

content: Doar sohnpadahkkok indoa Ipoa pwa, “Koawoa kidal pwa Pharisee‑ok lioaski dahkij ma Koawoa pwahla?”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “Suhkoa ohroj ma Joamoaiho nehnloannge johpwa poadokdi nen wijwijdahjang,
joah injinohki irai! Jounkaweid majkunpwi arai. Doar ma armaj majkun men kahlwa emen armaj majkun ara nen kipdihoang nehn lippwo.”

content: Peter pwehnglahng Ih, “Kawoahwoahda woahwoahn karajraj pasen.”
Jesus japoang irai,

content.text: “Kamwai kahjik oar loalkoangla, doahr iraihok ma joaloalkoang?
Kamwai johpwa woahwoahki? Mehkij ma koawoa kangla indihla nehn kapehdimwen kin pel injang nehn palwoaroamwen.
A me ma injang nehn oawoa, kin sapda jang nehn mohngiong, ioar kin kajaminihla armaj.
Lamlam nauna kin injang nehn mohngiong, ioar kin kahrehda, kojarmaj, kamwahl, nenek, pirap, likamw, karaun mwahl, pel lahlahwe.
Mehpwiai ioar kin kajaminihla armaj. A jaudi mwinge johpwa amwumwla!”

content: En Lihmen Ah Pwojon
Jesus injang wijahu inla wijahkij ipen kahnihmw in Tyre apel Sidon.

Lihn Canaan men, ma kin koaukoaujoan wijahu, indoa ipoa, ngil koalik poangpoanglahng Ih, “Maing, koawoa ma nihn David, kadek oang ngoahi! Noai jerpein men mine ma ngen jaus ne dilingla; ih kin minmine nehn apwal koalik.”
A Jesus johpwa pwahla lal oau oang ih. Nah sohnpadahkkok sohla Ipoa, engdehn poaki Ih, “Kadarla lihen! Ih kadroapwoa kisai ki ah poakpoak en.”
A Jesus japoang liho,

content.text: “Ngoahi, koadoaddoardohng ipen jihpw joaloangla in mihn Israel oar doari.”

content: A liho sohla ipoa dairukdihoang in pwoalkoa, “Maing, jeuweje ngoahi!”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “Johpwa pwung en kihjang kenen jerihkan mwinge peidlahng doahk kan.”

content: “Mehlel, Maing,” liho japoang, “a doahk kan kin pel kang mwoarmwoarin mwinge kan ma mwoardi pehn en laplappok sehpil.”
Doar Jesus ken japoang ih,

content.text: “Koawoa lihmen ma anki pwojon inenin koalik! Dahkij ma koawoa poaki nen pwoaihoang koawoa.”

content: Nehn anjoauwohr nah jerpeinno mwehuda.
Jesus Kemwehuwihla Armaj Dihrdir
Jesus injang wijahu, alu paianla poahrinjedin Galilee. Ih doauda pohn dol oau mwindi.

Pokon koalik oau indoa Ipoa, wahdohng Ih armaj mwoasor, armaj majkun, armaj dangpel, armaj loahsoang, apel dir ma anki joangjoangoan kahpwal in palwar, irai wahdo kihdi ipen ehn Jesus. Ih kemwehuwihla ohroj.

Pokonno pwuriamweikihla ahr kapangda doahr armaj loahsoanngok kakla lallal, armaj dangpellok mwehula, armaj mwoasorrok ne kakla alu, apel araihok ma majkun ne kapangda wija. Irai kapngahki Koahs in Israel.
Jesus Kamwinge Armaj Pahkid
Jesus panginpene nah sohnpadahkkok ipoa Ih pwehng irai,

content.text: “Ngoahi ipwilkihda armaj pwiai pwa irai minminehki Ipoai rehn jiluh, doar ne pel rojla kanrai mwinge. Ngoahi johpwa nimen kadarpijoang irai nen irai johpwa mwinge, pwadoar irai mwehlehlla nehn allok.”

content: Sohnpadahkkok idoakkoang Ih, “A ia wija kamai kak kihjang mwinge nehn japwsoahn oauwe ma en isar oang pokon oauwe?”
Jesus idoak oang irai,

content.text: “Lopwon in pilahwa doapoa mine ipamwai?”

content: Irai japoang, “Lopwon ijuh, apel mwumw siksik jipidpwi.”
Jesus pwehng pokonno en mwindi pohn pwirej.
Doar ih oaloa lopwon ijuhwo pwilihki mwummwok, kapingkalahnganki oang Koahs, sipwangpijoang, kioang nah sohnpadahkkok, sohnpadahkkok wud nehk oang pokonno.
Irai ohroj mwinge oaroh moad. Sohnpadahkkok rikda luhwen mwingehk wiahda kiam ijuh.
Dirin irai ma pwili mwinge rehnno, woal 4000 (pahkid), li apel jeri jehpwili waddoang.
Doar Jesus kadar pijoang armajjok, Ih doauda pohn pohs pas, jeilahng ipen koaujoan in Magadan.

footnotes.text: jamarai — Epwi Puk Joarwi mehjwa insingdi jamarai ke inarai
